page.layout: One column of running text, with numbered entries set as short paragraphs. In the right margin, a vertical line of printed text runs alongside the entries XIII to XVII.

main_text.p: ferit eos, neque præceperit eis, & omnino non profint populo huic. Ierem.23,32.

Audacia] Sequuntur spiritum suum, & quæ non viderunt. Vident vanitatem & divinant mendacium. Multis modis fecerunt, ut errarent populus, dicentes pacé esse ubi nulla esset pax, quumque alius[pseudopropheta] extruit luteum parietem, ecce illi obducunt illum infulfo tectorio. Ezech.13,3,9,10.
Crudelitas] Similes sunt leoni rugienti, prædanti prædam: animas comedunt, robur & res pretiosas capiunt, viduas eius multiplicant in medio eius. Ezech. 23,25.IESVITARVM.
Adulationes fraudulentæ] Malitia sua exhilarant Rege, & medaciis suis Principes. Hose.7,3.
Rapacitas] Concupiscunt agros & rapiunt, domosque concupiscunt & adimunt: opprimentes virum cum domo eius, quemque cum possessione sua. Mich.2,2.
Ambitio fallax] Si vir ventosus & falsus mentiatur, dicens, stillabo tibi pro vino aut pro potu inebriante, is stillator [doctor] est populi huius. Mich.2,11.
Ventris cura] Mordentes dentibus suis proclamant pacem, & in eum, qui non indiderit

page.notes: The vertical text in the right margin reads IESVITARVM. and is set sideways; it is recorded as a margin note. The word "infulfo" is printed as shown and may be a printing error for "insulso"; left as printed. The word "medaciis" is printed as shown and left as printed. The reference "Hose." is printed with a long s and transcribed as plain s. The entry XVII. continues on the next page, and the catchword D is at the lower right.
